Vintertid lever den oftast i kustnära vatten längs skyddade kuster.

Sommardräkt: askgrått huvud och hals, violettglänsande svart strupe, svart ovansida med vita fläckfält
Vinterdräkt: ljusgrå hjässa och bakhals, mörk ovansida, vit strupe och undersida

whereWhen.text: Storlommen häckar i hela Sverige utom på Öland, Gotland och i Skåne.

behaviour.text: Den äter fisk och ibland insekter, blötdjur, kräftdjur och växtdelar.
Födan hämtas genom dyk från vattenytan, och den går inte djupare än 5 meter.
Lommar ligger ganska lågt i vattnet, och storlommen lyfter genom att springa längs ytan som på en startbana.
I flykten sticker fötterna ut långt, så att vingarna ser ut att sitta mitt på kroppen.
Storlommen lever i par, oftast för livet.

lead.text: The Black-throated Loon is a loon that breeds on secluded, deep freshwater lakes.
In winter it usually lives in coastal waters along sheltered coasts.

fieldMarks.text: Slightly larger than a Mallard but much more slender
Summer: ash-grey head and neck, purple-glossed black throat, black back with white spot patches
Winter: pale grey crown and nape, dark upperparts, white throat and underparts
Dagger-shaped bill usually held horizontal when swimming, male and female look alike

voice.text: The territorial call sounds like ku-u-í-ki, kuí-ki, kuí-ki.
In the breeding season the male sings a high, rhythmic, whistling song.
The alarm call is a deep creaking, and in flight it gives a barking “kwow”.

whereWhen.text: The Black-throated Loon breeds throughout Sweden except on Öland, Gotland and in Skåne.
It is reported most in April and from July to September, and rarely reported in February.
Its share of all bird reports is highest in Dalarna, Kronoberg and Jämtland.
It is the provincial bird of Gästrikland.

behaviour.text: It eats fish and sometimes insects, molluscs, crustaceans and plant material.
It dives from the surface for food, never deeper than 5 metres.
Loons sit fairly low in the water, and it takes off by running along the surface as if on a runway.
In flight the feet stick out far, so the wings look placed mid-body.
It lives in pairs, usually for life.
